claim: Basic mode tasks can work with up to 25 million source and destination files, objects and directories per task execution between AWS storage services. If you transfer Amazon S3 objects with prefixes, the prefixes are treated as directories and count towards the quota. The quota is adjustable, but instead of requesting an increase you can create tasks that focus on specific directories using include and exclude filters.
question: How many files, objects and directories can a DataSync Basic mode task work with per task execution between AWS storage services?

qualifiers.scope: files, objects and directories per Basic mode task execution, between AWS storage services
qualifiers.condition: S3 prefixes count as directories; instead of an increase use include and exclude filters
